title: The Odd Coin
summary: Split into three groups, since a balance has three outcomes.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: Nine coins look the same, but one is slightly heavier.
You have a balance scale. What is the smallest number of weighings needed to find it?
points: Nine coins look the same, but one is slightly heavier.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Each weighing has three results: left heavier, right heavier or equal.
So you can split the coins into three groups.
points: Each weighing has three results: left heavier, right heavier or equal.

steps.title: The method: Split into three
sentences: If one side is heavier, the heavy coin is in that group, and if they balance it is among the 3 left out.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: If one is heavier, that is it, and if they balance, it is the third coin.

quiz.q: The odd coin is among 27. How many weighings are enough?
